about: Vaudreuil-Dorion is a bilingual Montérégie city at the confluence of the Ottawa River and Lac des Deux Montagnes, immediately west of the Island of Montréal. It sits at the junction of Highways 20 and 40 and has grown quickly from seigneurial villages into an off-island suburb. Vieux-Vaudreuil still faces the lake. About 43,000 people live in Vaudreuil-Dorion.
